rows.text: The key to piloting Yuna, Grand Summoner is understanding its core engine: Yuna acts as a rainbow mana dork that enters subsequent creatures with two bonus +1/+1 counters. When permanent with counters die, she transfers those counters onto other creatures, ensuring threats stay massive.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, Cyclonic Rift. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
